newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 posts 12th straight downward session.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 posts 12th straight downward session.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index posted its 12th straight declining session on Wednesday with SPT Telecom, the biggest issue on the bourse, and Komercni Banka, the biggest banking issue, again leading the way down.

SPT Telecom closed 40 crowns down at 3,050, but around midday it had fallen to as low as 3,010. Dealers said the picture had been even worse on the over-the-counter market where SPT, at one point, moved below 3,000.
Komercni Banka lost 25 crowns to 2,195. Komercni has fallen by more than seven percent in the last month.
Dealers said the gloom which has affected the Czech market in recent weeks was likely to continue for the foreseeable future especially in blue chip shares.
"This market could well go down for over one or two months and then rebound. This particularly applies to blue chips," said Petr Koblic of Zivnostenska Banka.

Analysts and equities traders say the lack of transparency in the Czech capital markets and inadequate protection for minority shareholders rights is driving investors away from the Czech bourse while comparable markets, such as Budapest, are booming.
